text_742.desc_loc: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.

rows.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
在地面某个位置留下一块持续一段时间的作用区域，单位留在其中就持续受影响（如寒冰之墙、臭云、烟幕）；区域跟着单位走的归光环，瞬间生效一次的不算
